poetryFrame.leftVertical: A SOUL DETACHED FROM EARTH'S GRIP, FLOATING ON WHISPERS OF STARLIGHT AND DREAMS.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: THE PORCELAIN HEART IS SACRED; IT WILL NOT BE PIERCED BY MUNDANE EXPECTATIONS.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: LOST IN THE VELVET SILENCE BEYOND ALL CHATTER
sonnetLines: Let the world spin far below,
Where solid rules no longer grow.
I drift on currents soft and deep,
Secrets that the high winds keep.
The laughter fades to distant chime,
A fragile self, a guarded gleam,
This flight from joy, this sweet domain.
I choose the height, the airy grace,
My spirit knows no binding chain,
Just starlight washing out the pain.
